The '''Lake Aire''' was a rundown [[Hotel/Legends|hotel]] located near the primary [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Lamuir IV]] in the [[Tapani sector/Legends|Tapani sector]]. It was managed by [[Japhod Ngaric]].
